svg.text: Agreement between the prototype and the reference instrument
Left: prototype against reference, with the identity line and the fitted line. Right: Bland-Altman plot, with the bias and the 95 % limits of agreement.
The difference is prototype minus reference, so a positive bias means the prototype reads higher than the reference instrument.
dashed: identity line · solid: fitted line
dashed: identity line · solid: fitted line
dashed: identity line · solid: fitted line
A positive bias means the prototype reads higher than the reference instrument. The limits of agreement are the mean difference plus and minus 1.96 standard deviations.
